Rina (product): Quick sync thread: need to lock launch gates for routing/tenant isolation roadmap. Customers pressing for residency + short rollback windows.

Ken (eng-arch): Main decision: soft-affinity vs hard slices. Soft-affinity gets us out faster; hard slices required for firm SLAs. Estimate: soft-affinity 2 wks, hard slices 10 wks.

Vik (eng-runtime): From perf sims: hard slices reduce p95 by ~35% but bump infra by ~28%. Also need KV cache rehydrate plan for evacuations.

Sasha (sales): Two pilots demand: (1) enforced region residency (contracted) and (2) <15m rollback during cutover. They'll want audit logs.

Anya (security): Residency enforcement must be opt-in per contract. Cross-region fallback must be explicit and logged. KMS locality required for Private.

Rina (product): Proposed minimal launch gates:
- Tiering: Hosted (soft-affinity), Dedicated (dedicated pools + SLA), Private (VPC + KMS)
- SLOs: Hosted p95 token latency <=330ms, Dedicated p95 <=210ms (seq512 synthetic)
- Canary: 1% traffic for 30m, rollback if error_rate >1% or p95 regression >20%
- Evacuation: documented drain + KV rehydrate target 30m
- Security: KMS validated for Private; fallback threat model documented

Ken (eng-arch): I'll add the routing precedence matrix and fallback_policy schema to the policy repo.

Vik (eng-runtime): I'll add canary pipeline + load tests. ETA: EOD Thu for draft CI jobs.

Sasha (sales): I'll collect exact contract wording from pilots and share by Wed.

Anya (security): Will prepare a short threat-model note for failover by Wed as well.

ci-bot: branch product/routing/gates-1777004321 created and PR opened (draft) https://redwood.internal/prs/2601 :link:

Rina (product): Thanks everyone. We'll review PR asynchronously; weekly 30m if blockers surface. :thumbsup:
